text:
alex_k: quick RFC follow-up: sketched a minimal control-plane swap flow to respect data residency during failover.

maria_dev: how do we handle in-flight requests with KV cache refs?

alex_k: two paths: 1) drain+proxy shadowing until KV TTLs expire (fast), 2) synchronous lease handoff (slow but consistent). preferring drain+proxy with consent checks.

sam_ops: proxy forwarding may violate residency. need a consent gate.

alex_k: agreed. proxy only forwards if tenant.cross_region_consent=true. otherwise 409 + Retry-After and operator signal.

patrick_arch: make consent a tenant config in control-plane so routers can cache it.

maria_dev: streaming needs special handling. allow pinned streams to finish locally; mirror audit logs.

elena_pm: product: surface three admin modes: no-forward, consent-forward, emergency-consent. customers choose outage vs forwarding.

alex_k: control-plane API: PATCH /tenants/:id with resource_version for optimistic concurrency.

maria_dev: yes, include tenant.resource_version to avoid races.

alex_k: headers: X-Residency-Mode: hold|normal, X-Residency-Decision: allow|deny|unknown.

sam_ops: unknown -> deny by default. ops can authorize emergency-consent (two-person approval, timebound).

patrick_arch: long-term: split lease metadata into a lightweight "assertor" service that answers is_writable(tenant,region) <5ms P95. it subscribes to control-plane events.

maria_dev: bootstrap/partition: assertor caches with TTL. if control-plane unreachable and cache expired, proxies default to conservative deny.

deploy-bot: canary started: assertor v1.0 -> 10% traffic. alert if p95 > 50ms or error-rate > 0.5%.

alex_k: next steps: short RFC PR with tenant states, PATCH shape, assertor contract, proxy header semantics. ping me for quick review.

patrick_arch: will review.

maria_dev: I'll add tests for state transitions and header propagation.

elena_pm: I'll draft UI copy and customer docs for the three modes and emergency workflow.

alex_k: thanks, posting PR link shortly. :rocket:
